name: Mai Chau to Moc Chau
summary: Stay on National Highway 6. It climbs out of the Mai Chau valley over Thung Khe pass and into Son La province to the Moc Chau plateau. Buses heading for Son La use the same road.

modes.note: Buses between Hà Nội and Sơn La or Điện Biên run National Highway 6 past the Mai Châu turn-off. Vietnam Tourism tells travelers on them to ask the driver to stop there. The same road continues to Mộc Châu. No clock for this leg was printed.
National Highway 6 crosses Thung Khe pass and enters Sơn La province through Vân Hồ (Wikivoyage). Kilometres and minutes for this leg were not on an official page.

seoTitle: Mai Chau to Moc Chau — National Highway 6 over Thung Khe
seoDescription: Mai Chau to Moc Chau runs on National Highway 6 over Thung Khe pass to the plateau, by bus, car, or motorbike.

faqs.q: Is the Hoa Binh–Moc Chau expressway open?
faqs.a: No. An inspection on 8 October 2026 found it still under construction, with the contract opening in the first quarter of 2028. Use National Highway 6.

faqs.q: Can I go the other way, Moc Chau to Mai Chau?
faqs.a: Yes. Take National Highway 6 southeast over Thung Khe pass into the Mai Chau valley.
